doc.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022

title: Lost gigs and hardship with other women
summary: She lost some gigs for being female but had more trouble with women on the bandstand.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: You know it’s both ways. You know if I don’t get respect by a man I know how to put them in their place. You know? And it happened that I lost some gigs because I was a female and I was not — but I also say that you know I lost those, so the hardest time I had unfortunately is with women, other women musicians. I noticed that I have great female musicians that I’m friends with and we really think alike and we are really kind of mellow, we do our job. But you know a lot of hard time I had on a bandstand I had, I
would say more hard time with women than with men, believe it or not. And it is unfortunate because I think you know helping each other would make a big difference.
